replace.description: Replacement text (this field is named 'replace' — NOT 'new_str'/'new_string'/'replacement').

start_line.description: Limit the search range to start at this 1-based line (inclusive). Use with end_line for precision.

end_line.description: Limit the search range to end at this 1-based line (inclusive).

replace_mode.description: [search_replace mode] When there are multiple matches: 'first' replaces only the first, 'all' replaces all (requires explicit choice).

operation.description: Edit operation. Default 'search_replace'. Other modes use line numbers instead of search strings.

text.description: [insert_after / replace_line mode] The text to insert or use as replacement.

after_line.description: [insert_after mode] Insert text after this line number (1-based). 0 = at the beginning of the file.

line.description: [replace_line mode] The line number to replace (1-based).

dry_run.description: [delete_lines mode] If true, preview what would be deleted without modifying the file. Returns the lines that would be removed.
